panels.general_description: Six EEG-and-video tiles of seizure 1 with printed video-time labels.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A, framed and titled "Seizure 1", is a grid of six tiles in two rows of three. Each tile pairs a multichannel EEG screenshot on the left with a grayscale overhead video still of a hospital bed on the right. A red "time m:ss" label on a black strip sits at the top-left of each video still and reads, in reading order, "time 0:12", "time 0:32", "time 0:54", "time 1:24", "time 2:54", "time 3:32". The EEG screenshots differ between tiles: some show dense dark vertical bands across all channels, others show separated wave traces. The video stills show a person on a bed with side rails and white linen in varying postures; in one still a partial second figure and a hand appear at the left edge, and in the fourth tile a black rectangular block overlies part of the left edge of the video still.
